title: Supreme Court of New Zealand judgment (courtsofnz.govt.nz)

recognise.court_line: IN THE SUPREME COURT OF NEW ZEALAND
recognise.te_reo_line: I TE KŌTI MANA NUI O AOTEAROA

signals.measured_on: 45 held NZSC judgments; held judgments' first two pages, 21 October 2026 (registers/courts, courts-1)

signals_note: counts of documents carrying each marker, measured on the held documents' text layers without a model
ocr: none: text layer only; a judgment with no text layer on page 1 is set aside for the page reader (ruling 62)

tables.judgments: one row: neutral citation, court, registry, case numbers, judgment date and its basis, hearing, judges, heading, outcome (closed vocabulary), paragraph count, suppression and its kinds
tables.judgment_parties: one row per party and role in the caption; a consolidated appeal one row per party; a withheld name NULL
tables.paragraphs: number and page of each numbered paragraph in sequence; no text

notes: Several case numbers mark a consolidated appeal. The orders under JUDGMENT OF THE COURT carry the outcome; REASONS follow with the numbered paragraphs.
applies_to: documents the courts lane holds, from 21 October 2026
process: Read every page's text layer with layout kept (pdftotext -layout); no page reader.
Take the citation only from a line of its own after the court line; a banner above it may cite another judgment.

A role in the singular holds one party however many lines its name wraps; a role in the plural holds one party per line once wrapped names are rejoined, a wrapped list split at commas and ANDs outside brackets and marked low.
Keep an anonymised party as printed (an initial, an initial with a case number); never expand it.

Withhold every party name but the Crown's and a printed initial when the judgment carries a suppression banner, an order in its text, or a ledger order, or another document of its citation does; the name to courts_private only.
Never store a caption line no grammar took, the running head or the counsel lines: counts only.
gates: Every listed document is a judgment row or a catch-log line (read.py asserts it).
Every role a counsel line is 'for' is held by a party of the caption, bar the known printed inconsistencies (check.py).
No published party name in a judgment carrying a suppression marker or a ledger order, bar the Crown and a court-printed initial (check.py).
